name: Fallaji
description: Nomads who raided and occupied Yotia for ten years.

timeline.summary: Hajar convinces the Qadir to appoint Mishra as tutor to his son, though Mishra stays rakiq.
timeline.quote: Hajar convinced the Qadir to appoint Mishra as a tutor to his son

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Qadir orders Hajar to have Mishra killed after his son's first war campaign.
timeline.quote: the Qadir ordered Hajar to have Mishra killed after his son's first war campaign

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Qadir's son becomes the new Qadir and appoints Mishra his raki.
timeline.quote: appointed Mishra his raki

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Almaazan songmages of Sumifa surrender to Mishra and offer their powers to the Fallaji Empire to avoid destruction.
timeline.quote: surrendered to Mishra and offered their powers to the Fallaji Empire in the war to avoid the destruction of their nation

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi enslave Mishra; he sees a Phyrexian realm in a vision, controls a dragon engine with the Weakstone and is accepted by the tribe, later confederating the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Later he can confederate the several Fallaji tribes under his central control.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza pursues the Fallaji with ornithopters into the Western Desert and is lured deeper into the sands.
timeline.quote: Urza's troops are lured even further into the unforgiving sandy landscape.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra confederates various Fallaji tribes under his central control.
timeline.quote: Over time, Mishra was able to confederate various tribes under his central control.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The trading conference at Korliss ends in an attack that provokes the brothers' struggle into open conflict.
timeline.quote: It provoked the brothers' struggle into open conflict.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Fallaji lure the Kroog forces deep into the Western Desert, leaving Kroog undefended.
timeline.quote: By luring the Kroog forces deeper into the Western Desert, the Fallaji accomplished two things

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra is enslaved by the Fallaji, freed by Hajar, learns he can control a dragon engine, and begins the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: Mishra found that he could control it .

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Mishra and the Weakstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The new Qadir promotes Mishra to raki and they set out to unify the Fallaji; Mishra meets Ashnod.
timeline.quote: promoted Mishra from rakiq to raki

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nearly all the Fallaji are killed in the Last Battle.
timeline.quote: Nearly all the Fallaji were killed in the Last Battle.

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashnod served as Mishra's confidante in Fallaji weapons development.
timeline.quote: Ashnod served as Mishra's confidante while he led Fallaji weapons development before the Brothers' War.

citation.text: Ashnod (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza wins the Warlord's daughter's hand in Yotia and takes Tawnos as apprentice, while Mishra tames a dragon engine with the Weakstone and unites the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Mishra discovers a dragon engine war machine and tames it with his Weakstone.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the peace negotiations, the Warlord attacks the Fallaji using Urza's machines before the brothers can reconcile; Mishra escapes.
timeline.quote: the Warlord attacks the Fallaji using Urza's machines

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fallaji troops attack the plaza barricade, and Llora orders Sanwell, Rica and Carlo to flank the dragon engine.
timeline.quote: Find a way to flank the engine and bring it down, pilot!

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: A column of Fallaji brasscaps appears and Sanwell sends Sword One and Sword Two to attack.
timeline.quote: Sword One," Sanwell cried.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The two avengers slaughter the Fallaji front ranks, but Sword Two loses an arm and the Fallaji overrun Sword Two and Sword Three.
timeline.quote: The Fallaji brasscaps advanced, driven by their officers behind

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The Fallaji explode Sword Two's powerstone, burning Carlo and wounding Sanwell and Rica.
timeline.quote: The brasscaps detonated their bomb lances and killed Sword Two.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Fallaji crossbowmen kill the crawling Carlo as Sanwell and Rica hide.
timeline.quote: A flurry of crossbow bolts thudded into Carlo's back, killing him.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Aiman, a wounded Fallaji soldier pierced by three arrows, lies among the dead of Kroog crying for water.
timeline.quote: Three arrows. He'd been hit.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: A sergeant gives Farid a golden coin as her regiment shuffles through the trench to make room for replacements.
timeline.quote: Replacements due in this afternoon.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Mishra's dragon engines draw Korlis into the war between Yotia and the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Mishra's dragon engines changed that.

citation.text: Survivor of Korlis (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Brothers' War the tribes are united under the Suwwardi and later ruled by Mishra; Fallaji infantry fight at Kroog and Terisia City.
timeline.quote: During the Brothers' War the tribes were united at last under the Suwwardi tribe

citation.text: "Fallaji Empire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Fallaji push the Argivians back from Tomakul.
timeline.quote: managed to push the Argivians back

citation.text: "Fallaji Empire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nearly all Fallaji die in the Last Battle and the empire collapses; Tomakul and Zegon are ruined.
timeline.quote: Nearly all the Fallaji were killed in the Last Battle, and the empire collapsed after the war.

citation.text: "Fallaji Empire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Combined Kingdoms nearly besiege Tomakul but fall back before the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: but had to fall back due to overwhelming resistance from the Fallaji

citation.text: "Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The trio retreats into an alley as Fallaji troops advance.
timeline.quote: the trio retreated into an alley to escape the advancing enemy forces

citation.text: "Carlo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Carlo is burned, crawls toward his comrades shouting for help, and is struck down by crossbow bolts.
timeline.quote: Carlo was struck down by crossbow bolts before he could be saved.

citation.text: "Carlo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Four months after the failed Peace Talks, the Fallaji strike and Kroog falls in a single morning.
timeline.quote: Four months after the failed Peace Talks at Kroog , the Fallaji struck, and the fall of the city happened in a single morning.

citation.text: "Fall of Kroog", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The avengers are overwhelmed by dragon engines; Carlo and others die while Sanwell and Rica escape to Hench.
timeline.quote: while Sanwell and Rica managed to escape to Hench.

citation.text: "Fall of Kroog", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra, denied support by the city council, sends his armies to besiege Terisia City.
timeline.quote: His armies were then sent to besiege Terisia City for their refusal.

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix betrays the city and opens the gates to the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: finally betrayed the city after several months of siege, and opened the gates to the onslaught

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Markos took charge of a strategic barricade in an abandoned market plaza and organized the Yotian defenders.
timeline.quote: Markos took charge of a strategic barricade in an abandoned market plaza

citation.text: "Markos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The dragon engine Traxos obliterated the barricade and incinerated many defenders including Markos.
timeline.quote: the dragon engine’s attack obliterated the barricade and incinerated many of the defenders, including Lieutenant Markos

citation.text: "Markos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Fallaji flee across the Kher Ridges, harassed by ornithopters and ground troops.
timeline.quote: The Fallaji fled across the Kher Ridges

citation.text: "Peace Summit at Korlinda", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra initiates the second summit, held with only Yotia and the Fallaji Empire, after acquiring three more dragon engines.
timeline.quote: it was Mishra who initiated the invitation to the summit

citation.text: "Peace Talks at Kroog", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Carlo is killed by Fallaji soldiers; Sanwell and Rica flee the city.
timeline.quote: Carlo was killed by Fallaji soldiers

citation.text: "Rica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terisian defenses hold the Fallaji at bay for months while civilians are evacuated through secret passages.
timeline.quote: The Terisian defenses were implacable and held the Fallaji at bay for months

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra decides to eradicate Terisia City; Hajar's Fallaji besiege it for months.
timeline.quote: Mishra decided to eradicate Terisia City.

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix betrays the city and opens the gates, leading to its fall.
timeline.quote: They finally betrayed the city and opened the gates to the onslaught

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda, talks over the Sword Marches break down into insults and the Warlord activates ornithopters that bomb the dragon engine.
timeline.quote: the Warlord activated the squad of ornithopters

citation.text: "Warlord of Kroog", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Peace Summit at Korlinda fails because both countries claim the Sword Marches; the Warlord dies there.
timeline.quote: which failed spectacularly because both countries claimed the Sword Marches as their own

citation.text: "Yotia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yotia remains under Fallaji occupation for ten years before liberation by Argive and Korlis.
timeline.quote: Yotia would remain under Fallaji occupation for ten years

citation.text: "Yotia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
